title: Ordinary baseline: consume it on unobserved turns, pin take() end to end, and rename tests that state the old contract
outcome: An ordinary turn that runs without an observation trace leaves its successor without a baseline, so the next traced turn never compares across it with the older sighting. A test fails if the closing turn's consumption of the baseline (runtime_checkpoint.take()) is reverted to a copy: a seeded baseline, then a closing turn whose sighting is refused or unresolved, gives a successor reporting assumed_missing_baseline. The receipt-settlement tests in engram_source_observations.rs are named for what they actually pin.
acceptance: Ordinary baseline: consume it on unobserved turns, pin take() end to end, and rename tests that state the old contract is done
